entries.subject: eso-optical shipped image lens
entries.finding: Default H-alpha/R/V/B publication TIFF preserves the full 93.49 by 62.61 arcmin footprint at 4000 by 2679 pixels. Registration and native separation qualify processing; the 450 arcsec optical support taper is authored and does not infer a physical boundary.

entries.subject: eso-vista shipped image lens
entries.finding: J/H/Ks publication TIFF, 4000 by 2202 pixels, 71.81 by 39.54 arcmin. The caption identifies near-IR bands despite an H-alpha metadata mislabel. Its current 240 arcsec source-edge fade softens missing coverage without adding gas.

entries.subject: spitzer-mid-infrared shipped image lens
entries.finding: IRAC 3.6/4.5/5.8/8 plus MIPS 24 micrometre false color, 1757 by 1417 pixels over 35.73 by 28.81 arcmin. AstroPix supplies the matching WCS; different beams and the narrow footprint remain explicit, with a 240 arcsec source-edge fade.

entries.subject: Gaia DR3 astrometry/photometry and Bailer-Jones EDR3 geometric distances
entries.finding: 226 Gaia sources in an authored 60 pc sphere, G < 12, shared across the three lenses; the sparse brightness selection is intentional and not filled with artificial stars. Actual catalogue source IDs, median distances and uncertainty intervals are retained. Sphere, quality cuts, budget, brightness response and fade are display selections, not a membership survey; Cardiel BP-RP display color uses a neutral fallback outside its valid range.

entries.subject: Wright 2019 cluster scale and stellar kinematics
entries.finding: The application adopts 1326 -69/+77 pc from the cluster analysis, including its systematic treatment. Anisotropic stellar expansion does not justify a spherical gas-expansion law or membership for every field star.

entries.subject: Arias and Tiwari Hourglass/eastern-front interpretations
entries.finding: Local extinction and front/veil order guide two bounded authored windows. The 1250 pc paper conversion only defines local angular scope; it does not replace the application distance. All depth coefficients and thickness are authored; no numerical cube is fitted.

entries.subject: Hubble central optical detail
entries.finding: The small heic1808a field remains provisional. Two bounded star-matching attempts found 0 matches against the 4K ESO source and 9 against a local full-resolution JPEG crop, below the unchanged 45-match gate. No new composite was promoted.
entries.revisitWhen: Obtain a qualified catalogue or intermediate optical image that passes spatially held-out registration without weakening the gate.

entries.subject: Hubble central near-infrared detail
entries.finding: The small central infrared sibling has its own preserved AVM but no qualified independent registration; it is not a full-Lagoon map and its background stars do not establish membership.
entries.revisitWhen: Pass independent registration on its own source grid with a qualified reference and retain its limited footprint.

entries.subject: Herschel normalized PACS 160 micrometre HiPS
entries.finding: The inspected display has seams/clipping and extensive zero/nonfinite samples, including missing central Lagoon support. It is not calibrated surface brightness or a science-validity mask; the recorded terms page was unavailable during intake.
entries.revisitWhen: Acquire usable native calibrated coverage and masks with verified terms, then qualify source registration; zero-filled sky cannot constrain missing emission.

entries.subject: Barba shocks, Kahle clumps and Singh LVM maps
entries.finding: These papers were inspected but their line maps, 37 clump pointings and LVM numerical arrays are not fitted. Beam offsets, incomplete Hi-GAL coverage, foreground contamination, masks and uncertainty must remain explicit; figures are not calibrated arrays.
entries.revisitWhen: Acquire native arrays with sky grids, masks, uncertainties and tracer-specific selection before using velocities, extinction or line diagnostics.

entries.subject: Full 23569 by 15784 ESO JPEG comparison
entries.finding: The downloaded compressed full-size optical JPEG preserves the same field and showed a washed-out centre; it yielded only nine central Hubble matches. It is not the 697.9 MB lossless master and was not substituted into the delivered source.
entries.revisitWhen: Use only if a specified registration/detail comparison demonstrates an improvement with qualified photometry and an unchanged match gate.

entries.subject: Optical window and infrared edge correction
entries.finding: The current authored 450 arcsec optical window and 240 arcsec infrared source-edge fade replace sharper boundaries. Recorded target checks retain 99.917 percent of bright-core signal and 3.819 percent of the former outermost-strip signal; these are source-target metrics, not screen brightness or physical cloud edges.

entries.subject: Filament loss, halos and oblique layers
entries.finding: The source-backed single front still softens fine filaments, retains stellar-halo blobs and shows thin-layer/grid traces. Earlier result counts and residuals describe separate processing versions, not fresh scientific or visual acceptance.
entries.revisitWhen: Improve the same front/oblique/side observations with an explicit supported material/depth change; more sampling or exposure must not conceal wrong geometry.
